items.title: Show HN: A reader ranked Indian news platform powered by feed
items.contentSnippet:
Lokutu news brings together news articles from different sources and presents them in a simple, reader-focused format. Articles are ranked based on reader votes. The aim is to highlight the stories that readers consider important, rather than relying solely on popularity or engagement. All articles are fetched at 07 AM IST everyday and only the articles fetched on the same date are shown. The site is more similar to a newpaper, rather than real time news websites or applications.

items.title: Show HN: Jinfer – AI inference engine for the JVM. AI in a jar
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN,
Some would call AI on the JVM quixotic. And so, Quixotic AI was born.
jinfer is an inference engine for the JVM: chat, vision, audio, embeddings, reranking, and TTS. No Python runtime, no ONNX, no Docker containers, no sidecar process, no IPC. Finally, AI in a jar.
The stack underneath is built for the JVM rather than bolted onto it:
    toknroll: pure-Java tokenizers, zero dependencies
    gguf / safetensors: read and write llama.cpp and HuggingFace model formats
    jam: quantized matmu
